title: ÆTHER: Steppu Veyyi Raa (Telugu mass dance, 1 min, lyrics by Mr. Kavi)
maker: ElevenLabs Music API on the owner's paid plan

positive_styles: high-energy Telugu film mass dance song, wedding baraat night in Hyderabad, fun and cheeky, a big singalong
bright D Mixolydian, raga-shaped melody with fast gamakam slides and bends, never minor, never sad
one steady 132 BPM teenmaar groove from start to end, the swinging mass bounce that flips into a triplet feel at section ends
loud dry dappu frame drums and tasha snares played by a real street band, punchy modern kick, deep synth bass
a wedding brass band (trumpets, trombone, sousaphone) playing a short catchy 5-note brass riff as the signature hook
funky synth stabs and a bright electric mandolin answering the voice
an energetic young male mass voice singing in Telugu with clear film-song diction
a big crowd chorus shouting the one-word answers
loud, bright, wide modern film mix, real drums and brass dry and natural, no heavy echo
starts with the dappu drums alone for two beats, the brass band crashes in with the riff, full beat by 4 s
he shouts the line like an announcement

brief.notes: Jithesh 30 Oct 18:16: 'telugu dance track of 1 minute'. Funny story + call-and-answer hook (lesson from v18/v19). Telangana teenmaar dappu groove + wedding brass band riff as our own sounds (rule 9); avoids earlier signature devices (3-note call, hey chants, reversed swell, thavil/nadaswaram, whistle hook, oops stop). Surprise: snare stutter + one-beat silence into the hook; key lift on the final hook. Romanised Tenglish lines (worked on Yaaru nee?). story: A shy software guy at a Hyderabad wedding baraat gets dragged onto the floor by his uncle. His legs shake, then the dappu drums hit and he turns into a mass hero. Twist: the grandmother tightens her saree and out-dances everyone.
